profile.summary: Hello, my name is Teerath. I enjoy researching the development of technology in many fields of study such as space, agriculture, and medicine. My main technical experiences so far have been in software development. As I have strived to improve my skills, I learned several programming languages, frameworks, APIs, etc., which in turn has improved my level of confidence in my work ethic and effectiveness to learn/improve rapidly.
